attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder (T1547.001)
attackers_goals: Command execution and persistence on the host.
description: Runonce.exe executes commands under the Registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce, typically on computer boot and user logon events.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Suspicious runonce.exe parent process
